headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.55
summary: Outgoing Xbox friend requests can now be listed and canceled, the dashboard friends card refreshes with the active account, and all dialog actions refresh their lists automatically.

items.text: Show sent friend requests in the Requests tab and allow canceling them.
Refresh the dashboard Xbox friends card when the active account changes or the app starts.
Refresh friends and request lists automatically after accept, decline, cancel, and remove actions.
Apply the selected theme color to Xbox friends tabs, buttons, and dialogs.
